data.body: **[P2] Do not treat ReplayChildren ancestors as proof of abandonment.** A `SUCCEEDED` context with `ContextDetails.ReplayChildren` is re-executed on resume, so its unfinished descendants may still be traversed and acquire real parents. This check can instead export a completion under `Workflow` at a `PENDING` boundary, after which replay deduplication prevents correction. Carry the ReplayChildren flag into the inspected metadata and detach only when replay will actually skip the ancestor; add a ReplayChildren regression test.
